name: collapsible
title: Collapsible 折叠区
description: 展开或收起单个内容区域。

whenToUse: 展开或收起单个区域，如高级设置、文件树
responsive: 窄屏下可收起次要内容

files.content:
# Collapsible 设计规范

- 用于单块可以展开收起的内容（“显示更多”、高级选项）；多块并列的展开内容用 Accordion。
- `Collapsible.Trigger` 本身就是按钮：要用 Button 样式时通过 `{#snippet child({ props })}` 渲染 Button（检查规则 `valar/trigger-child-snippet`）；只有图标的触发按钮要有 `aria-label`。
- 触发按钮的文字或图标随状态变化（“显示更多”／“收起”），展开状态用 `bind:open` 控制。
- 属性分组用 `appearance="properties"`。触发器直接放在根组件内，使用 28 px 高的透明按钮和 16 px 的装饰箭头。标记为 `data-slot="collapsible-indicator"` 的箭头在 150 ms 内转动。内容即时展开或收起，减少动态效果时箭头也即时更新。

<script lang="ts">
	import { Collapsible as CollapsiblePrimitive } from "bits-ui";
	import { cn } from "$UTILS$.js";

	let {
		ref = $bindable(null),
		class: className,
		...restProps
	}: CollapsiblePrimitive.ContentProps = $props();
</script>

<CollapsiblePrimitive.Content
	bind:ref
	data-slot="collapsible-content"
	class={cn(className)}
	{...restProps}
/>

<script lang="ts">
	import { Collapsible as CollapsiblePrimitive } from "bits-ui";
	import { cn } from "$UTILS$.js";

	let {
		ref = $bindable(null),
		class: className,
		...restProps
	}: CollapsiblePrimitive.TriggerProps = $props();
</script>

<CollapsiblePrimitive.Trigger
	bind:ref
	data-slot="collapsible-trigger"
	class={cn("min-w-0 focus-visible:outline-1 focus-visible:-outline-offset-1 focus-visible:outline-ring disabled:opacity-50", className)}
	{...restProps}
/>

<script lang="ts">
	import { Collapsible as CollapsiblePrimitive } from "bits-ui";
	import { cn } from "$UTILS$.js";

	let {
		ref = $bindable(null),
		open = $bindable(false),
		appearance = "default",
		class: className,
		...restProps
	}: CollapsiblePrimitive.RootProps & {
		appearance?: "default" | "properties";
	} = $props();
</script>

<CollapsiblePrimitive.Root
	bind:ref
	bind:open
	data-slot="collapsible"
	data-appearance={appearance}
	class={cn(appearance === "properties" && "*:data-[slot=collapsible-trigger]:flex *:data-[slot=collapsible-trigger]:min-h-7 *:data-[slot=collapsible-trigger]:py-1 *:data-[slot=collapsible-trigger]:wrap-anywhere *:data-[slot=collapsible-trigger]:w-full *:data-[slot=collapsible-trigger]:items-center *:data-[slot=collapsible-trigger]:gap-[3px] *:data-[slot=collapsible-trigger]:rounded-lg *:data-[slot=collapsible-trigger]:bg-transparent *:data-[slot=collapsible-trigger]:px-2 *:data-[slot=collapsible-trigger]:text-start *:data-[slot=collapsible-trigger]:text-[13px]/5 *:data-[slot=collapsible-trigger]:font-medium *:data-[slot=collapsible-trigger]:text-[color:lch(40%_1_282)] *:data-[slot=collapsible-trigger]:enabled:hover:text-[color:lch(20%_1_282)] dark:*:data-[slot=collapsible-trigger]:text-[color:lch(63.304%_1.425_272)] dark:*:data-[slot=collapsible-trigger]:enabled:hover:text-[color:lch(90.826%_1.425_272)] *:data-[slot=collapsible-trigger]:focus-visible:outline-1 *:data-[slot=collapsible-trigger]:focus-visible:-outline-offset-1 *:data-[slot=collapsible-trigger]:focus-visible:outline-ring *:data-[slot=collapsible-trigger]:disabled:opacity-50 [&>[data-slot=collapsible-trigger]_[data-slot=collapsible-indicator]]:size-4 [&>[data-slot=collapsible-trigger]_[data-slot=collapsible-indicator]]:shrink-0 [&>[data-slot=collapsible-trigger]_[data-slot=collapsible-indicator]]:transition-transform [&>[data-slot=collapsible-trigger]_[data-slot=collapsible-indicator]]:duration-150 motion-reduce:[&>[data-slot=collapsible-trigger]_[data-slot=collapsible-indicator]]:transition-none data-open:[&>[data-slot=collapsible-trigger]_[data-slot=collapsible-indicator]]:rotate-90 rtl:data-closed:[&>[data-slot=collapsible-trigger]_[data-slot=collapsible-indicator]]:rotate-180", className)}
	{...restProps}
/>
